summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board meeting scheduled for May 20, 2026, to approve first-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing is a routine notification of an earnings release and conference call date. No transaction terms, premiums, advisor appointments, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is a standard periodic report under Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers, containing no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is analogous to a U.S. earnings press release notice. Watch for the actual earnings results and any forward guidance on May 20.
